answer.reason: Several events of the story took place at Bethany: Lazarus raised, Jesus anointed, and his ascension.

clauses.english: was where Jesus raised Lazarus from the dead
clauses.quote: where Lazarus was, which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead

clauses.english: was where a woman anointed Jesus in Simon the leper's house
clauses.quote: a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment

clauses.english: was where Jesus blessed his disciples and was carried up into heaven
clauses.quote: while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven

doubts: MAT 21:17 and MRK 11:11-12 only say Jesus lodged there, which was left out.
JHN 12:3 may describe the same anointing as MAT 26 and MRK 14, but the verses do not say so, so it was not used.
